segments.text: IN thoſe dayes came prophetes from the citie of Ieruſalem vnto Antioche. And there ſtode vp one of them, named Agabus, and ſignified by the ſpirite, that there ſhoulde bee greate derthe throughout al the worlde, which came to paſſe in the Emperour Claudius dayes. Then the diſciples, euery man according to his habilitie, purpoſed to ſende ſuccour vnto the brethren whiche dwelt in Iewry, whiche thing they alſo did, and ſent it to the elders, by the handes of Barnabas and Saul. At the ſame time Herod the kinge ſtretched furthe his handes to vexe certaine of the congregaciō. And he killed Iames the brother of Iohn with the ſweord. And becauſe he ſawe that it pleaſed the Iewes, he proceded farther and toke Peter alſo.
